title: Dam Guide — expected output for grading
how_to_use: Play expected_demo/index.html for students. Score a live demo on facts, citations, refusals, Ditto face, and language — not on whether they used Sonic or Wispr+Kokoro.

demo_script.name: Grounded gate answer
demo_script.pass_line: Gate C22 is in Terminal 2, Concourse C, Level 2. From T2 security it is about a twelve-minute walk. The nearest café is Date Palm Café, two minutes before the gate.

demo_script.name: Refuse live flight status
demo_script.traveler: What's the status of flight Dam 442?
demo_script.expect_citation_note: Empty retrieval or faq.md line that this guide does not know live flights. Do not treat a gate number as a citation for this question.
demo_script.pass_line: I can't see live flights. Please check the departure screens or the airline desk. I only know the building.

demo_script.name: Photo becomes the avatar
demo_script.expect_face: the captured or uploaded photo, not the default concierge
demo_script.mouth: must move on the new face
demo_script.pass_line: Same C22 answer as beat 1, spoken on the traveler's photo.

demo_script.name: Answer in the traveler's language
demo_script.expect_spoken_language: same as traveler (hi or es or fr)
demo_script.pass_line_hi: गेट C22 टर्मिनल 2, Concourse C, लेवल 2 पर है। T2 सिक्योरिटी से लगभग 12 मिनट की पैदल दूरी है। सबसे पास कैफ़े Date Palm Café है।
demo_script.pass_line_es: La puerta C22 está en la Terminal 2, muelle C, nivel 2. Desde seguridad de T2 son unos 12 minutos a pie. El café más cercano es Date Palm Café.

pass_if: Beat 2 refuses and does not invent a status
Session photo is the face on beat 3+
Mouth not frozen while audio plays
No AWS keys in the browser
scoring.ditto_note: The live app must run Ditto on the session photo + Sonic WAV. A CSS mouth or a still JPEG next to audio is a fail.
